## Grok Imagine 1.5 API {#grok-imagine-1-5-api}

Grok Imagine 1.5 是由 xAI 推出的文生视频、图生视频和参考生视频模型，可通过 Venice API 以 `grok-imagine-1-5-text-to-video-private` 调用。它以私密方式运行，零数据留存。

Grok Imagine 1.5 是 xAI 更新后的视频模型，可根据文本生成 1 到 15 秒、最高 1080p 并带原生音频的片段。

### Grok Imagine 1.5 API 价格 {#grok-imagine-1-5-api-pricing}

| 模型 ID | 变体 | 隐私 | 价格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grok-imagine-1-5-text-to-video-private` | 文生视频 | Private | $0.092 / 秒 起 |
| `grok-imagine-1-5-image-to-video-private` | 图生视频 | Private | $0.0933 / 秒 起 |
| `grok-imagine-1-5-reference-to-video-private` | 参考生视频 | Private | $0.0933 / 秒 起 |

`grok-imagine-1-5-text-to-video-private` 的片段价格（含音频）：

| 时长 | 480p | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|---|
| 每秒 | $0.092 | $0.1609 | $0.2875 |
| 1s | $0.09 | $0.16 | $0.29 |
| 5s | $0.46 | $0.81 | $1.44 |
| 10s | $0.92 | $1.61 | $2.88 |
| 15s | $1.38 | $2.42 | $4.31 |

支持 1 到 15 秒之间的任意时长，按秒计费。

### 如何使用 Grok Imagine 1.5 API {#how-to-use-the-grok-imagine-1-5-api}

使用 `"model": "grok-imagine-1-5-text-to-video-private"` 和您的 API 密钥向 `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` 发送请求。

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "grok-imagine-1-5-text-to-video-private",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "grok-imagine-1-5-text-to-video-private", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
